connector.name: Baselight
connector.registryDescription: Query Baselight's public catalog of 70,000+ datasets - finance, demographics, sports, and more.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.baselight.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.baselight, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Baselight API key. Generate one at https://baselight.app under account settings.
